1x8._comment_teacher_forcing_e2e: Rebased at this key's own length. Measured WH T3K 1x8 at prefill_512/max_new_tokens_500 with the optimization configuration (prefill SDPA hifi4_nodest, lm_head hifi3_destacc, GEMMA4_OPROJ_TUNED off): worst step 0.351333 at decode[348], mean 0.949157, and bit-reproducible across repeats. Floor is the worst step less ~3% margin, the same convention the p128 floor used (0.5628 -> 0.55). It replaces 0.55, which was measured at p128_n128 and was never rebased when the default case became 512/500 — that gate had been failing at this length before any of the accuracy work (0.423845 at the same decode[348]) and had simply never been selected in a run. This is a REGRESSION DETECTOR at the measured configuration, not a correctness target: it is only valid for this configuration and this length, and other fidelity settings move it a lot (hifi4 0.423845, hifi3 0.458874, hifi4_nodest 0.351333). Read the mean, not the floor, as the accuracy signal — a per-step full-vocab PCC is weak here because 262k entries under tanh final_logit_softcapping(30.0) means row variance, not device error, dominates a single step. Prefer the KL / max|dlogit| block that test_teacher_forcing_e2e prints. test_full_model 0.98 is a ~6-token prompt, not this e2e path.
